Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E45 yr old male patient came with c\/c of\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-increased\u0026nbsp; involuntary movements (tremors) ,since 1 day.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-increased drowsiness since 1 day.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of presenting of illness- patient was apparently asymptomatic 8months back then he developed pedal edema, shortness of breath,distension of abdomen, itching of skin,jaundice and is diagnosed to have \"chronic decompensated liver disease\" with portal HTN with Ascites with grade 1 esophageal varcies with Times corporicet with HTN\u0026nbsp; since 3yrs.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe was admitted in our hospital on 7\/1\/2023 gTreatment given was :-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;1.salt restriction less than 2gm \/day\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2.fluid restriction less than\u0026nbsp; 1.5l \/day\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3.Tab .lasix 40mg PO \/BD for 10days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4.Tab. Spririnolactone 25mg PO \/OD for 10days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E5.syrup.lactulose 15ml TID for 10days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E6.LuLitin cream l\/a OD 2 weeks .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E7.ebernet plus\u0026nbsp; cream\u0026nbsp; l\/a OD 2 weeks.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E8.Tab Teczine 10mg SOS.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E9.absorb dusting powder thrice daily.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was on regular follow up since then.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E10days back he had shortness of breath and pedal edema and came to OPD for follow up and is on conservative management.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3days back- patient had\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;h\/o fever ,low grade ,relieved after taking medication (dolo 650mg ) not a\/w cold\/cough\/vomiting \/loose stools \/pain abdomen \/headache.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIncreased drowsiness and involuntary movements since 1 day , aggravated with movement and relieved on taking rest\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPast history -\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EKnown case of HTN since 4 years ,n\/k\/c\/o DM,asthma ,tb, epilepsy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eh\/o involuntary micturation,defeaction.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETremors - increased with movements,absent at rest.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o fall,head injury,seizure activity.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPersonal history:-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet- mixed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite -narmal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and bladder movement-regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E35 year old male farmer by occupation is brought to opd with\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC\/O vomiting since 8days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of presenting illness:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic one month back since then he is having occasional episodes of vomitings which are increased in frequency since past\u0026nbsp; 8 days that is of\u0026nbsp; 1 - 2 episodes per day,Non projectile,Non bilious,Not blood tinged,Food particles as content associated with fever,Not associated with pain abdomen\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E8 months back patient suffered with ? Chickenpox for 1.5 month .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2months after recovery from chicken pox he is diagnosed as having\u0026nbsp; DM (probably type 1)when patient presented with unconscious state\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o of\u0026nbsp; shortness of breath( grade 2) for 1 month\u0026nbsp; which is intermittent ( increased during night),Associated with cough and fever\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBurning micturation present\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECough initially Non productive later productive ,Associated with scanty sputum,Non blood tinged\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFever is low grade, intermittent,associated with night sweats not associated with chills and rigors\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWeight loss of 8 to 10 kgs\u0026nbsp; from past 3 months\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EProgressive increase in weakness which is\u0026nbsp; increased in severity since past 10days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDecreased appetite since past 1 month\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESince 4months he was on Mixtard\u0026nbsp; 10 units once daily for his DM\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBut Patient stopped using these for past 1 month\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EN\/k\/c\/o htn asthma cad tb epilepsy\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENon alcoholic,Non smoker,No relevant family history\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETreated outside for UTI - ecoli\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; given for 4days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOphthalmology referral done showed :- mild NPDR changes noted and adviced strict glycemic control, review to opthalmology opinion for every 6 months,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDate-12\/4\/23 Urine culture report showed methicillin sensitivity staphylococcus aureus resistance to penicillins and sensitivity to co trimaxazole ,….and I\/v\/o renal failure creatinine clearnce 23ml\/hr cotrimoxazole (Dose adjustement was done(50%of regular dose) was given for 5 days .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI\/v\/o anaemia evaluation was done, Hb-7.2 gm\/dl,Microcytic hypo chronic ,Reticount :-0.5\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EStool for occult blood( + )\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESurgery opinion was taken I\/v\/o previous h\/o hemorrhoids and constipation\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EP\/R examination showed - skin around the glutial clefts normal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-no external skin tags, fissures, haemorrhoids, sinuses or fistulas\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-surrounding external skin stained with stool .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-anal tone is normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-hard stoll pellets found in the rectum\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- all stool pellets have been cleaned upto the level of finger insertion.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-glove stained with dark yellow coloured stool\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAdviced - syp cremaffin 30ml\/po\/hs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-proctoscopy after soap water enema\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- advice colonoscopy to rule out\u0026nbsp; losses ,gi bleed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-upper GI endoscopy i\/v\/o any upper GI bleed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EUpper GI endoscopy was planned I\/v\/o any upper GI bleed which showed esophageal candidiasis, bile reflux gastritis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEndocrinology opinion was taken and was suggested Inj Lantus 10 units at @10pm\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EUrology opinion was taken again\u0026nbsp;
